dict.string: ClickBait controls Finder, Notes and System Events to carry out your commands, like making a note or switching Dark Mode, and Music or Spotify from its notch panel.
ClickBait's notch calendar shows events for the date you select. They stay on this Mac.

ClickBait listens while you hold Control+Option so it can hear your question.
